title: Yonatan Sheida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yevamot 122a: Rabbi Hanina said, 'Yonatan Shida told me: they (the demons) have a reflection; a reflection of a reflection they do not have.' (And Rashi explains: he was a demon, or one expert in them.) In Gittin 66a it appears as “Yonatan my son told me,” a reading Hyman considers erroneous.

notes.text: In the consulted Gittin 66a the wording is “Yonatan my son taught me.” Yevamot 122a has “Yonatan Sheida told me.” Both passages distinguish a reflection from its reflection.
